notes.title: Demo Updated with Tutorials
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45296404/9fdd1f0fae56120d4e600fc72108ca628fc6c692.png[/img]

As requested by a number of players in the community, I've added five tutorial missions to the Jet Attack Demo to teach the basics of the game. These include:

[olist]
[*] Basics of how to fly
[*] Gun combat
[*] Close range missiles
[*] BVR (Beyond Visual Range) combat
[*] Carrier training - land as many times as you can in 3 minutes to score points. Points are awarded based on which wire you catch, the #3 wire being the best
[/olist]

Please leave any feedback and tutorials you'd like to see added in future. Thanks to everyone in the community who's left feedback on the demo!

notes.title: Jet Attack Demo Update!
notes.notes:
We've updated the Jet Attack Demo to include six missions and co-op multiplayer. Missions include Carrier Operations, F-117 strikes, protecting Air Force One and Apache Strike. You can also choose from one of 5 jets in co-op multiplayer. Play on our dedicated servers located in US, UAE, EU and Australia.

The full game will include over 100+ missions, multiple multiplayer modes, 10+ game modes, a mission editor and more! Wishlist today to be notified when the full release is available

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45296404/e336a6956d76cc15eb5ed91fc7ad90681edbe14e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Jet Attack Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
The demo for Jet Attack is now live! It includes [b]dogfight game mode[/b] and [b]all dogfight jets[/b] are available in the demo. If you have any feedback or questions please create a discussion or join us on Discord and I'll answer your questions and fix any bugs.
